info.title: Didban Mali Fresh Rebuild API
info.description: Design contract, not a running server. D01-D08 are binding. Financial values are IRR Decimal strings; unknown is null with a reason. All financial endpoints are company scoped. Mutation services must enforce idempotency, authorization and version/transaction protocols.

SessionCookie.name: didban_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax; rotate at login/reset and revoke at logout. Never use localStorage for sessions.

CsrfToken.description: Bound to an anonymous/authenticated cookie; no authentication authority.

ManualToken.description: One-time manually delivered secret; never logged or sent by email automatically.

AnswerRequest.description: Validate against current issue constraints too; unknown only when explicitly allowed. If-Match uses the current session version, not the issue creation version.
